findings.description: UsageKey is (account_id, metric, month), but the lookup uses (account_id, prior, metric). It never matches, so previous_total is always None and change is always 'n/a'. The month-over-month feature never works.
findings.title: Previous-month lookup uses wrong key order

findings.description: After yielding a DailyTotal when the key changes, `quantity` is not reset to 0. The next day/metric/account starts with the previous group's total added to it, so all daily totals after the first are inflated, as are monthly totals, peaks and averages.
findings.suggestion: Set quantity = 0 after the yield, before adding the current event's quantity.
findings.title: Quantity accumulator not reset between groups

findings.description: `if not self.previous_total` treats a previous total of 0 as nothing to compare. This is arguably intended to avoid division by zero, but the guard also hides legitimate cases; it is minor.
findings.suggestion: Keep the zero guard but make the intent explicit (`is None or == 0`).
findings.title: Zero previous total hidden while previous_total is shown
